description: Change of use from a dwelling (Use Class C3) to a children's care home (Use Class C2) for up to 3 child residents aged 7 -17 years supported by 4 carers on a shift rotation basis
borough: London Borough of Barking and Dagenham
decision_conditions: <p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The proposed development shall achieve Secured by Design principles to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and the Metropolitan Police, details of which shall be provided to the Local Planning Authority for its written approval prior to the first occupation of the approved development. All security measures applied to the approved development shall be permanently retained thereafter.&nbsp; </span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">The premises shall be used as a&nbsp; small-scale children's care home for up to 3 child residents aged 7-17 years old and for no other purpose (including any other purpose in Class C2 of the Schedule to the Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) (or in any provision equivalent to that Class in any statutory instrument revoking and re-enacting that Order with or without modification)). </span></span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">At all times the use of the premises shall be operated in strict accordance with the Design and Access Statement submitted in support of the application.&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">The applicant shall notify the Council of any forthcoming placements and provide confirmation of referral origin upon request.</span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">A minimum of 1x cycle parking space for staff/visitors must be implemented in accordance with The Local Plan Policy DMT3 and The London Plan 2021 policy T5. Thereafter, it shall be retained as such in perpetuity.</span></span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Details of refuse enclosures showing the design; location and external appearance shall submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority prior to occupation of the premises. The approved enclosures shall be provided before the commencement of the use and thereafter permanently retained.</span></span></p><p><br></p>

<p><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">Prior to occupation of the proposed development, a Noise Management Plan&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">outlining mitigation measures</span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">&nbsp;shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (LPA).&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>
The development hereby permitted shall be commenced before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

The development hereby approved shall only be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:

- DRAWING XXX REV XX DATED XX
- USE [SHIFT]+[ENTER] FOR REGULAR LINE SPACING
- USE [ENTER] FOR LARGER LINE SPACING

No other drawings or documents apply.

<p style="text-align:justify"><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">Prior to occupation of the proposed development, a robust</span><span style="font-size:11pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">&nbsp;Operational Management Plan&nbsp;</span></span><span style="font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: 11pt;">shall have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority (LPA).&nbsp;</span></p><p style="text-align:justify"><br></p>
